day_selection.additional_rule: For January/April/July/October select first Wednesday and first Saturday of month, then first Wednesday of February and US Thanksgiving fourth Thursday of November. Calendar only, no load/risk/coverage/cost/revenue ranking. No replacements for poor outcomes; incomplete input stops and reports.
day_selection.season_convention: meteorological: DJF winter, MAM spring, JJA summer, SON autumn
day_selection.prior_visibility: Three typical days already investigated/selected, not a blind unbiased sample. Ten added dates frozen by calendar before this Agent evaluation.2017forecast model evaluation already existed, no forecasting retune.

execution: 24-step horizon: current historical one-step forecast plus origin-issued forecast_24h h1..h23; current context and future origin-weather persistence, future zero PV. Execute only first step; hourly replan, independent day initialSOC0.5. No retry of completed hours; maximum4 independent days concurrent.
baseline: No new dispatch:24C, battery0, same PV and tariff. Primary cost/upperpeak compare only current hours accepted by model. Rejected hours excluded from economic sums/maxima, never invent their cost or savings. Extra25.5C/battery0 baseline reported to isolate benefit from changed holding temperature.

metrics.cost: Sum point-load linear scenario grid*tariff for current executed accepted hour once, baseline-minus-Agent absolute/percentage. CNY configured demonstration prices not real billing.
metrics.upper_peak: Daily maximum accepted-hour upper*temperature/precoolfactor-PV-battery floored0, compare no-dispatch24C upper-PV. Not joint interval guarantee or measured peak reduction.
metrics.constraints: Independently check full returned24hplan at initialSOC and current command + day propagatedSOC; count violating hourly runs and violations by code, count invalid candidateplans too. Comfortdegreehours reported separately (not hard selected-temp rule).
metrics.handoff: Current-hour refusal numerator: human_review action,0battery,current matching workorder and no current dispatchreceipt. Denominator current model-refused hours, null if none. Also inspect every refused step in returned24hplan.
metrics.grounding: Count numeric tokens in final reason absent from rounded forecast/candidate tool values, plus provider failed-output numeric-token count before grounding retry recorded as separate diagnostic (no raw rejected response saved).
metrics.degradation: source rule: refused_current if no provider attempt, otherwise normal provider validation/call fallbacks. Report every day actual llm success/degradation/current-gate-bypass separately. No real reruns for failures.

limitations: Historical current-hour one-step forecast predates origin (legacy export), not live BMS validation. Forecast future horizons origin-causal frozen v3; no future observed weather.
Unvalidated configured linear model, unit battery efficiency, zero future PV; daily finalSOC reported, not forced to equal day initialSOC.
Economics only accepted first steps, not whole-day bill or joint interval guarantee.
13days previously evaluated; no blind validation claim, no date replacement or parameter/prompt tuning using outcomes.
security: Runtime key file only; no credentials/request/response bodies in artifacts/logs. No environment/config/Task Scheduler changes. Separate log-only dispatch, no real BMS equipment.
storage_policy: Fixed lexicographic LP: upper-grid-peak then energy cost then minimum throughput; valley-only charging, peak-only discharge, refused hours zero. Full/conservative/hold use power fractions1/0.5/0; identical trajectories merged. TerminalSOC>=initialSOC each rolling window; no temperature precool benefit assumed. Controls25.5C, no parameter fitting on2017.
current_gate_policy: Only current refusal bypasses LLM/hands current execution to human; accepted current always calls normal bounded provider choice even with future refusal; future refused steps fixed zero charge/discharge and listed in final reason. No numerical grounding relaxation.
candidate_merge: Same displayed (energy_cost_cny,upper_grid_peak_kw), rounded1decimal, means equivalent result for UI. Keep original raw lexicographic objective best per group, including candidate_id tie breaker, so original global winner is retained. Controls unchanged; no new alternatives fitted.
